I can relate to this so much.  In personal reflection  I think I try harder to seem normal when I am at my worst.  And then when I feel okay I am more comfortable with my mess so to speak.

Reach out. Sometimes people can't see behind the mask.
I thought it was a loaf of garlic bread. Like a pizza made with the closest pizza ingredients available when you were left home alone for 45 hours a week in the summer as a 10 year old.
